mapper.select: SELECT id AS source_id, COALESCE(display_name, id) AS name FROM ${schema}.sources WHERE upper(id) = upper(#{q}) OR strpos(lower(display_name), lower(#{q})) > 0 ORDER BY (upper(id) = upper(#{q})) DESC, display_name NULLS LAST, id LIMIT 25
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO v2_openalex_work (source_id, work_id, year, title, doi, authors) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{w.workId}, #{w.year}, #{w.title}, #{w.doi}, #{w.authors})
ON CONFLICT (source_id, work_id) DO UPDATE SET year = EXCLUDED.year, title = EXCLUDED.title, doi = EXCLUDED.doi, authors = EXCLUDED.authors, imported_at = now()
mapper.sql: SELECT w.work_id, w.publication_year AS year, w.title, w.doi, COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(wa.author_name, ';' ORDER BY wa.author_id) FROM work_author wa WHERE wa.work_id = w.work_id), '') AS authors FROM work_source ws JOIN work w ON w.work_id = ws.work_id WHERE ws.source_id = #{sourceId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v2_openalex_work v WHERE v.source_id = ws.source_id AND v.work_id = w.work_id)
mapper.select: SELECT file_id FROM original_file_job WHERE matched_work_id = #{workId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE v2_paper SET matched_work_id = #{workId}, record_version = record_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE paper_id = #{paperId}
